summary: Comprehensive regression testing of Super Admin 2FA (TOTP) feature — backend + frontend. 20/20 pytest cases passed covering full flow (setup, verify-setup, status, login→requires_2fa, verify TOTP, verify backup code (one-shot), expired pending token, regenerate, recover-start/complete, disable, role-guard 403 for non super_admin). Frontend UI verified end-to-end: Settings tab → TwoFactorAuthCard renders, 'Bật 2FA' opens modal with QR SVG + secret + code input, verify-setup switches to 8-backup-codes grid, enabled-state shows Tắt 2FA + Tạo lại mã backup buttons, logout→re-login triggers 2FA verify screen (title 'Xác thực hai bước'), bad code shows 'Mã xác thực không đúng', valid TOTP issues session and lands on /admin, /2fa-recover page renders with confirm button, Disable 2FA cleanup worked. Admin account restored to no-2FA state at end of testing (totp_* keys removed).

issues: Non-blocking React warning in console: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (LoginPage)' — setState-in-render detected during 2FA mode transition; does not affect functionality but should be wrapped in useEffect.

backend_setup_guard.details: POST /api/auth/2fa/setup returns 403 for shop_owner (fashion@proid.vn); returns secret/otpauth_url/issuer='Pro ID Shop'/account=admin email for super_admin.

backend_verify_setup.details: POST /api/auth/2fa/verify-setup with bad code → 400; with valid TOTP → 200 with enabled:true and 8 backup codes matching 'XXXX-XXXX' format.

backend_status.details: GET /api/auth/2fa/status returns enabled,enabled_at,backup_codes_remaining; remaining decrements after a backup code is used.

backend_login_requires_2fa.details: POST /api/auth/login for 2FA-enabled admin returns {requires_2fa:true, pending_token, email} and sets no access_token cookie.

backend_verify_totp.details: POST /api/auth/2fa/verify with valid TOTP → 200 {role:'super_admin', token, used_backup_code:false}; invalid code → 401.

backend_verify_backup_one_shot.details: Backup code verifies once with used_backup_code:true and is rejected on subsequent attempts (401).

backend_expired_pending.details: POST /api/auth/2fa/verify with malformed/invalid pending_token → 400 with 'Token không hợp lệ'/'Phiên 2FA đã hết hạn'.

backend_regenerate.details: POST /api/auth/2fa/backup-codes/regenerate — bad TOTP → 401; valid TOTP → new 8 codes, old codes no longer accepted at /auth/2fa/verify.

backend_recover_start.details: Returns generic success for both unknown emails and the admin email (no enumeration). Resend email send wrapped in try/except.

backend_recover_complete.details: Invalid token → 400. Valid flow exercised by code review (password_resets collection uses purpose='2fa_recovery', 30-min expiry).

backend_disable.details: Bad code → 401. Valid TOTP → 200 enabled:false. Next login no longer requires 2FA.

frontend_settings_card.details: TwoFactorAuthCard visible in /admin Settings tab; when off shows warning banner + 'Bật 2FA ngay' button.

frontend_setup_modal.details: Modal renders QR SVG (qrcode.react), displays base32 secret, 6-digit code input, Hủy/Xác nhận buttons. After verify-setup succeeds, switches to backup codes view with 8 <code> elements (e.g. 'MUJ8-53FJ').

frontend_enabled_state.details: Once 2FA enabled, twofa-disable-btn and twofa-regen-btn become visible.

frontend_login_2fa_screen.details: After password entry, UI transitions to 2FA mode. twofa-title, twofa-code-input, twofa-submit-button, twofa-back-btn, twofa-lost-btn/twofa-recover-btn present. Bad code shows twofa-error = 'Mã xác thực không đúng'. Valid TOTP lands on /admin.

frontend_recover_page.details: /2fa-recover?token=XXX renders data-testid='2fa-recover-page' with confirm-recover-btn. Invalid token shows error state after click.

frontend_disable_modal.details: twofa-disable-modal opens with twofa-disable-code-input + twofa-disable-confirm; valid TOTP disables 2FA and enable-btn reappears.

action_items: (Low priority) Fix React setState-in-render warning in LoginPage.js during 2FA mode transition — wrap the offending navigation/state update in useEffect to prevent the 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering LoginPage' console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: 2FA recover-start uses FRONTEND_URL from env but falls back to empty string if unset — the generated link would then be '/2fa-recover?token=...' (relative). Current .env has FRONTEND_URL so fine, but consider failing loudly if env missing.

disable_2fa accepts TOTP OR backup code — good defense. But backup-code usage in disable() does NOT mark the code as used (unlike /auth/2fa/verify). Since 2FA is being fully removed (totp_backup_codes unset) this is fine, but document this intentional behaviour.

create_2fa_pending_token includes role in JWT and /auth/2fa/verify trusts it as-is. If a user's role were changed in DB between login and 2FA verify the issued access_token would carry the stale role. Low-risk but consider re-reading role from DB at verify step.
regenerate_backup_codes only accepts TOTP (not backup codes), which matches spec; good.
Recovery link email content includes admin email in HTML — safe since it is only emailed to that address, but consider escaping if user-controlled in future.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 2FA UI flows verified: setup → backup codes → 2FA login → recover page → disable)

seed_data_creation: None. Admin account was toggled on/off 2FA during testing and restored to no-2FA state at end (totp_* keys unset in db.users). One orphan password_resets doc with purpose='2fa_recovery' remains from test_recover_start — harmless, TTL 30 min.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 2FA feature complete and working on both backend + frontend. pyotp 2.9.0 used. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_2fa.py (20 cases); run with: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_2fa.py -v. UI testids added: twofa-card, twofa-enable-btn, twofa-setup-modal, twofa-setup-code-input, twofa-setup-verify, twofa-setup-cancel, twofa-setup-done, twofa-backup-codes (children are <code> not <div>), twofa-disable-btn, twofa-regen-btn, twofa-disable-modal, twofa-disable-code-input, twofa-disable-confirm, twofa-regen-modal, twofa-regen-code-input, twofa-regen-confirm. LoginPage: twofa-title, twofa-code-input, twofa-submit-button, twofa-error, twofa-back-btn, twofa-lost-btn, twofa-recover-btn. Recover page: 2fa-recover-page, confirm-recover-btn. If re-testing and admin has leftover 2FA, clean via: db.users.update_one({email:'daominhhai129@gmail.com'},{$unset:{totp_secret:'',totp_enabled:'',totp_enabled_at:'',totp_backup_codes:'',totp_pending_secret:''}}). Login submit testid is 'auth-submit-button' (not 'login-submit-button').
